messages:
sam (PM): quick sync — we need to finalize which items for Optimize toolkit MVP: batching heuristics, prefix cache, quantization recommendations, eval-triggered alerts. customer asks from Acme & HealthCo are pushing cache + quant first. thoughts?

maria (Eng): My read: cache + batching low effort, quant recs medium, eval alerts higher infra work. Cache + batching gives immediate p95 improvement for many workloads. :+1:

aj (ML): quantization guidance needs model-specific thresholds. we can ship coarse rules (int8 vs 4-bit) in v1, but per-model rollout later.

tess (Solutions): customers want deterministic perf gains. they'd accept coarse quant recs if we include rollback guidance and measured token-quality delta.

leo (SRE): eval-alerts touch infra (storage + eval hooks). want to scope to 'sampled evals' to start. also need retention policy.

sam (PM): propose MVP slice: 1) batching heuristics + runtime defaults, 2) prefix/KV cache + TTLs, 3) quant recommendations (coarse), NOT eval-alerts. can we do that in Q2 alpha?

maria (Eng): yes for batching+cache. quant coarse recs need model benching infra but we can surface 'recommended profile' based on family. set acceptance: automated perf test shows >=20% token cost reduction on 3/5 customers.

aj (ML): acceptance for quant: recommend profiles for 5 model families + documented quality delta <2% on relevant evals.

tess (Solutions): request we include a customer-facing rollout checklist: preflight evals, canary ratio, fallback policy.

sam (PM): adding canary & rollback into scope. also need API + console UX: model-level suggs, 'apply recommended profile' button, and audit log.

maria (Eng): UX looks small; console will need an opt-in flag. For APIs: add /recommendations endpoint. example config:
```json
{
  "model":"redwood-open-7b",
  "recommended_profile":"int8_fast",
  "expected_savings":"~30%",
  "quality_delta":"~0.8%"
}
```

leo (SRE): for canary: default 5% traffic for 24h + perf + quality checks. if regressions, auto rollback. we need alerting hooks; suggest build eval-triggered-alerts as v1 infra for canary checks.

sam (PM): ok — so MVP ship excludes user-facing eval alerts but includes canary infra that can later surface as customer alerts. timeline check: eng says batching+cache + API + console + quant recs coarse for beta in 7w?

maria (Eng): 7 weeks seems tight but doable if we freeze scope to 'family-level profiles' and no per-model tuning.

aj (ML): I'll own family mapping and the initial benchmarks.

tess (Solutions): I'll prepare customer comms & rollout checklist.

sam (PM): great. action items: @maria sprints + ETA, @aj bench matrix due in 2w, @leo canary infra spec due in 1w, @tess customer checklist draft in 2w. cc deploy-bot for infra tickets.

deploy-bot: created tickets INF-1482, ML-223, UI-301 on behalf of thread.

sam (PM): thanks all — will sync on 2w checkin. :rocket:
